author: By Site staff
title: Madison police union addresses Mayor Rhodes-Conway
text: Madison’s Professional Police Officer Association is asking Mayor Satya Rhodes-Conway to educate herself in an open letter written to discuss missed opportunities.

summary: The Madison police union published an open letter asking the mayor to better educate herself following perceived missed opportunities.
